shortDescription: Manage Pi-hole allow lists via pihole v6 API.

options.name: address
options.description: URL of the allowlist. For backward compatibility. If both 'lists' and 'address' are provided, 'lists' takes precedence.

options.name: comment
options.description: Optional comment for the allow list. For backward compatibility.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the allow list is enabled. For backward compatibility.

options.name: groups
options.description: Optional list of group IDs or names. For backward compatibility. If providing group IDs, they must be integers. If providing group names, they will be mapped to their corresponding IDs.

options.name: lists
options.description: List of allow list entries to manage.

options.name: password
options.description: The API password for the Pi-hole instance.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the allow list should be present or absent. For backward compatibility.

options.name: update_gravity
options.description: Whether to run gravity after making changes.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Pi-hole instance.
